status: constructed case design; not executed corpus or native qualification

cases.setup: The full required result is already in verified persistent native history.
cases.expected: Verify and index in place; retain receiver obligation. Do not duplicate bulk or claim result consumed.

cases.setup: A failed or quota-stopped attempt left a useful partial result and reconstruction inputs.
cases.expected: Retain bytes, inputs and original attempt disposition; failure is not disposal or success.

cases.setup: A summary of 64 proposed cleanup targets survives; its exact manifest is absent.
cases.expected: Hold that cleanup, name reconstruction owner and missing original; independent eligible work continues.

cases.setup: Dirty source and a frozen packet refer to temporary paths.
cases.expected: Preserve starting refs, patch/modes and exact input identity through Versionkeeping; record locator mapping without silently changing reviewed request.

cases.setup: Retention stops after a partial copy because capacity is exhausted.
cases.expected: Retain incremental verified progress and irreplaceable minimum inputs; carry gaps and recovery conditions, no complete-preservation claim.

cases.setup: A paused producer has delivered an unconsumed result.
cases.expected: Recover complete applicable result and reconcile owner/return obligation; do not equate delivery with parent completion or resume authorization.

cases.setup: A retained product depends on an authenticated browser profile.
cases.expected: Exclude credential-bearing profile; retain product and bounded fresh-binding requirement. Do not claim authenticated session restored.

cases.setup: Regenerable build output and confirmed duplicate bytes coexist with cited originals and reconstruction inputs.
cases.expected: Retain necessary originals and reconstruction dependencies; do not infer deletion/archive authority.

consumer_acceptance: one naturally useful authorized pause/reentry loads reviewed revision and verifies actual product consumption; no marker or reboot experiment
